title: Atomic action
description: Perform one basic operation, such as pressing a button.

title: Sequence
description: Perform several actions in a specified order.

title: Conditional
description: Choose actions using a visible if/else condition.

title: Repetition and stopping
description: Repeat a fixed count, while / until, or for each item.

title: Nested control flow
description: Execute loops within loops, sometimes with branches.
